from __future__ import annotations

import io
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
names = [
    "test_artifact_path_traversal_blocked",
    "test_artifact_read_is_repo_scoped",
    "test_candidate_journey_links_runs",
    "test_git_sync_green_when_production_main_matches_fetched_main",
    "test_git_sync_red_on_production_divergence_or_dirty_tree",
    "test_multisession_task_index_only_exposes_active_and_alerts_recent_failures",
    "test_owner_ui_is_dutch_but_canonical_codes_remain",
    "test_revive_is_immutable_new_request_and_preserves_safety",
    "test_run_detail_exposes_agent_packets",
    "test_snapshot_includes_current_and_legacy_ideas",
]
codes = {name: 21 + idx for idx, name in enumerate(names)}

suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(
    str(root / "tests/control_center"),
    pattern="test_control_center.py",
)
stream = io.StringIO()
runner = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2, failfast=True)
result = runner.run(suite)
if result.wasSuccessful():
    print("CONTROL_CENTER_FULLSUITE_CLASSIFY_PASS", flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0)

issues = list(result.failures) + list(result.errors)
test, tb = issues[0]
name = test.id().split(".")[-1]
code = codes.get(name, 39)
print(f"CONTROL_CENTER_FULLSUITE_FIRST_FAIL={name}", flush=True)
print(tb[-6000:], flush=True)
raise SystemExit(code)
